question: The average of the squares of the first 45 natural numbers is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The average of the squares of the first n natural numbers is given by the direct formula: (n + 1)(2n + 1) ÷ 6.

Here, n = 45.

Average = (45 + 1)(2 × 45 + 1) ÷ 6

Average = (46 × 91) ÷ 6 = (23 × 91) ÷ 3

Average = 2093 ÷ 3 ≈ 697.67

**∴ The correct answer is 697.67.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of terms (n) = 45 natural numbers.

**Formula Used:**

Sum of squares of first n natural numbers = n(n + 1)(2n + 1) ÷ 6

Average = Sum ÷ n = (n + 1)(2n + 1) ÷ 6
